senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) [by one’s self, cmp. גּוּף, גַּף I,] single, alone, forsaken.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 3b:5">Ḥag. 3ᵇ</cite>; Mekh. Bo s. 16, a. e. <he>אין הדור י׳ וכ׳</he> that generation is not forsaken in which &c.—<he>אמן י׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A02039"><he>אָמֵן</he></cite>.—Esp.
<cite ref="Megillah 13a:5">Meg. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>המגדל י׳ וי׳ בתוך ביתו וכ׳</he> he who rears a male or female orphan in his house, is regarded as the parent.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 6:8">Tosef. Keth. VI, 8</cite> <he>י׳ וי׳ צריכין פרנסה מפרנסין את היתומה וכ׳</he> if an orphan boy and an orphan girl need public support, we must support the girl first &c.; <cite ref="Ketubot 67a:13">Keth. 67ᵃ</cite>.

Taan. 24ᵃ בי׳ וי׳ we were engaged in collecting for an orphaned couple to be married; a. v. fr.—יתומה בחיי האב self-depending in her father’s life-time, i.e. a minor over whom her father has no control, e.g. when he has given her away in marriage, and she being divorced or widowed returns to her paternal home.

senses.gloss: an animal whose mother died during or soon after childbirth.
(Law) a minor heir whom the authorities must protect by appointing a guardian to plead his cause &c.; in gen. heir (mostly in the plural).—Pl. יְתוֹמִים, יְתוֹמִין; f. יְתוֹמוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 70a:2">B. Mets. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>מעות של י׳</he> minor heirs’ funds.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 124a:2">B. Bath. 124ᵃ</cite> <he>שבח שהשביחו י׳ לאחר וכ׳</he> improvements which the heirs made after their father’s death (before division).

<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 6:1">Arakh. VI, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Arakhin 21b:28">21ᵇ</cite>) <he>שום הי׳</he> the assessment for public sale of minors’ (heirs’) property which the court sells to satisfy the decedent’s creditors.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 13:7">Yeb. XIII, 7</cite> <he>שתי אחיות י׳</he> two orphan sisters; a. fr.
